method: Unmodified standard viewer global Terrarium field; bilinear interpolation at pixel centers in the signed bridge frame. No flattening. Six-meter sampling oversamples the coarse mixed-source DEM.
attribution: Mapzen/Terrain Tiles; NASA/USGS and other open elevation sources
limitations: Approximate global viewer terrain; not surveyed rail/river levels. Vegetation and bridge returns can affect the field.
